status: conditional dated scenarios only; current target and upside withheld
units: USD millions, shares millions, per-share USD

capital.lease_policy: lease expense stays in EBIT; no separate subtraction in default bridge
capital.claim_policy: Full RSU/PSU share reserve, no forfeiture credit. Existing option exercise is endogenous. Add back existing unrecognized award expense over 1.5 years; charge all new SBC as cash replacement, no future share-growth assumption. Allocation of old award amortization is analyst approximation, not grant-level vesting schedule.
capital.repatriation_tax_warning: zero is conditional tax-efficient access, not verified tax-free availability
capital.option_valuation_limitation: Intrinsic-value exercise approximation using all30,025 outstanding options, only19,279 currently exercisable; not full option fair value, omits time value and vesting timing.
capital.psu_limitations: 1,845,728 is the disclosed aggregated unvested RSU/PSU rollforward, not proven maximum payout across every grant.2026 PSU maximum234,617 is disclosed separately; grant-level reconciliation remains unavailable. Award multiplier sensitivities are analyst stresses, not inferred maximum obligations.

common_assumptions.sbc_policy: GAAP operating margins include total SBC. Add back ONLY amortization of prevaluation outstanding awards (already included in diluted denominator); never add back future new-grant SBC.
common_assumptions.terminal_reinvestment: terminal growth requires g/25% incremental ROIC, separate from explicit netcapex and WC
common_assumptions.discount: year-end; H2 at0.5 years, 2027 at1.5, ...2035 at9.5
common_assumptions.probabilities: None; scenarios are conditional analyst choices, not calibrated distributions. No price target fitting.
common_assumptions.terminal_tax_policy: Same as explicit forecast: max(0, terminal EBIT times cash tax rate, terminal revenue times minimum revenue cash-tax rate). No unstated terminal tax normalization.
common_assumptions.funding_capacity_policy: Opening liquid assets plus model FCFF after cash-replacement treatment of future SBC. Stress proxy, not forecast bank cash. Includes no interest income, distributions, acquisitions or financing. Future tax/liquidity access conditional.

rationale.growth: Licensing precedes uncertain royalty ramp. Base FY2026 $125m near management $123.846–126.038m; bear deliberately misses guidance, bull exceeds. Later ramps are analyst judgments, not reported backlog.
rationale.margin: History 2016/17 GAAP EBIT margins about18–20%, recent GAAP losses; base recovers toward old profitability, bull requires stronger licensing/royalty scale, bear limited recovery.
rationale.wacc_g: Uncalibrated analyst sensitivity parameters; no claim of observed market cost of capital.
rationale.liquidity: Keep $30m operating reserve; do not assign full liquid assets as surplus. Offshore taxes tested separately.
